load_rgb_image: load an RGB image from a file path and return it as a normalized PyTorch tensor
get_random_cuda_device: get a random CUDA device string from available GPUs for testing custom kernels
assertClose: assert two tensors or arrays are close within relative and absolute tolerance
assertSeparate: assert two PyTorch tensors have their data stored in distinct memory locations
assertConstant: assert a tensor or array is entirely filled with a given scalar value
